title: YouTube started as a video dating site
summary: YouTube began in 2005 as a video dating site with the tagline 'Tune in, hook up'. Google agreed to buy it in October 2006 for $1.65 billion, when it reported more than 100 million video views a day.

beats.say: YouTube started as a video dating site.
beats.cap: YouTube began as a dating site

beats.say: Its tagline was tune in, hook up.
The domain name was registered on Valentine's Day, two thousand five.
The first video was posted in April two thousand five.
Users quickly began posting videos on any subject.
By December two thousand five, it reported eight million views a day.
By October two thousand six, it had more than one hundred million views a day.
That month, Google agreed to acquire it for one billion, six hundred fifty million dollars.
That was about twenty months after the company was founded.
A dating site idea became a video platform that Google bought.
